narratives.name: Practice Intent
narratives.description: Why partner go-to-market execution matters for Red Hat-partner ecosystem success.

narrativeContexts.context: Technology Red Hat partners possess deep customer relationships, domain expertise, and local market knowledge, but translating these advantages into consistent execution of Red Hat sales plays requires structured enablement, financial incentives, and technical collaboration resources that bridge the gap between Red Hat strategy and partner field execution.

Partners must master three interconnected execution dimensions: demand generation through co-branded campaigns and MDF-funded activities, deal management through structured registration and protection mechanisms, and technical collaboration through proofs of concept, workshops, and assessments that validate technology fit.

The practice provides partners with partner-specific sales play guides, self-service campaign execution tools, deal registration with protection periods and discount structures, and lifecycle rewards funding for hands-on customer engagement activities across six funded activity types.

Partners generate measurable pipeline aligned with Red Hat strategic themes, protect registered deals through structured incentive mechanisms, and deliver Red Hat-funded technical activities that validate technology fit for customers, creating a self-reinforcing cycle where successful execution drives higher tier standing and access to deeper collaboration resources.

narratives.name: Partner Play Selection
narratives.description: How partners evaluate and select Red Hat sales plays for execution.

narrativeContexts.context: Partners receive Red Hat sales play guides organized around strategic market themes, but these must be translated into partner-executable playbooks that incorporate partner-specific capabilities, customer relationships, and market positioning alongside Red Hat messaging and content architecture.

Partner organizations must assess which plays align with their technical capabilities, customer base, and market positioning, then prepare their sales, marketing, and technical teams to execute the play through partner-specific demand generation, deal registration, and technical collaboration activities.

Partner sales leadership evaluates play fit against existing customer segments and capability portfolio, marketing teams develop MDF-funded campaign plans aligned to play themes, and technical teams identify opportunities for funded proof-of-concept and workshop engagements that validate play messaging with prospective customers.

Partners have a clear execution plan connecting Red Hat play strategy to partner-specific customer engagement, with budget allocated for demand generation, sales teams trained on play messaging, and technical engagement opportunities scoped for pipeline acceleration.

narratives.name: Synergistic GTM Execution
narratives.description: How three GTM dimensions work together during play execution.

narrativeContexts.context: Play activation establishes the infrastructure for execution, but translating activated resources into measurable pipeline requires sustained, coordinated effort across partner sales, marketing, and technical teams operating in concert.

During execution, the three GTM dimensions work synergistically: demand generation campaigns source qualified leads that become registered deal opportunities; deal registration provides protection and economic incentives for sustained partner investment; and technical collaboration activities validate technology fit and advance deals toward closure.
Partners generate activity points across multiple categories contributing to tier advancement, while play-aligned pipeline grows through the coordinated execution of all three dimensions.

narratives.name: Campaign Execution Cycle
narratives.description: Systematic approach to planning, executing, measuring, and optimizing demand campaigns.

Performance data from campaign execution informs future investment allocation across demand generation marketing and business development categories.

narratives.name: Deal Registration Process
narratives.description: Structured process for qualifying and registering partner deal opportunities.

narrativeContexts.context: Partner seller identifies a customer opportunity aligned with Red Hat technology offerings within a sales play theme that meets deal registration qualification criteria.
The partner must qualify the opportunity, determine deal type, select route to market, and submit deal registration with sufficient detail to secure Red Hat approval and deal protection benefits.

Deal registration submission captures customer information, technology area, estimated value, expected timeline, and engagement plan. The Red Hat reviews for eligibility and approves with deal protection and discount structures confirmed.
The registered deal is protected for 180 days with activity points awarded, discount structures confirmed, and the opportunity entered into pipeline tracking for structured pre-sales engagement.

narratives.name: Partner Play Execution Value
narratives.description: How structured play execution drives consistent partner sales effectiveness.

narrativeContexts.context: Partners have deep customer relationships and domain expertise but need structured frameworks to consistently translate Red Hat technology value into customer-specific business cases.

Partner sales play guides provide partner-contextualized versions of Red Hat GTM strategy including Customer Lens, target personas, value drivers, and three-level content architecture. Partners weave Red Hat messaging with their own domain expertise.

Partners who effectively execute structured sales plays generate measurable pipeline aligned with Red Hat strategic themes, achieve higher deal registration win rates, and build competitive advantage through consistent customer engagement quality.

narratives.name: Strategic Renewal Management
narratives.description: Transforming subscription renewals from administrative events to strategic engagement opportunities.

Systematic lifecycle management uses intelligence tooling for early risk identification, incumbency discounts for competitive positioning, and lifecycle rewards activities for customer re-engagement.
Partners who treat lifecycle management as a disciplined practice generate higher renewal rates, stronger customer relationships, and more predictable revenue streams.

Performance insights drive specific recommendations for future GTM strategy: optimizing MDF allocation, adjusting sales play focus, and prioritizing technical engagement activity types.

patterns.name: Partner GTM Execution Lifecycle
patterns.description: End-to-end lifecycle coordinating partner demand generation, deal management, and technical collaboration through play execution.

patternViews.name: Prerequisites
patternViews.description: Partner program enrollment and GTM readiness established.

narrativeContexts.context: Partners discover Red Hat sales play opportunities through partner-specific play guides, evaluating which market themes align with their technical capabilities, customer base, and market positioning. The discovery phase involves three assessments: play-customer fit, capability-readiness, and investment-appetite.

patternViews.name: Activate and Enable
patternViews.description: Partner GTM infrastructure activated with campaigns launched.

narrativeContexts.context: The activation phase validates partner readiness for play execution. Marketing campaigns are launched through the demand platform with co-branded content. Initial deal registrations seed the pipeline. Technical engagement fund requests are submitted for customer proof activities.

patternViews.name: Execute and Convert
patternViews.description: Partners actively executing plays with pipeline flowing.

narrativeContexts.context: Execution phase is where the partner GTM framework proves its value. Partner sellers execute structured sales plays, marketing campaigns generate qualified leads, and technical teams deliver funded proofs of concept and workshops.

Deal management progresses from registration through protected selling to closure. Partners negotiate under deal protection, leveraging pre-sales activities and competitive positioning. Activity points accumulate across all categories, creating a compound tier advancement trajectory.

patternViews.name: Close and Renew
patternViews.description: Deals closed with incentives realized and customer lifecycle managed.

narrativeContexts.context: Deal closure realizes the full incentive stack. Win/loss analysis captures competitive and technical factors. Incumbency is established for renewal opportunities. Lifecycle rewards claims are processed with proof of performance documentation.

patternViews.name: Optimize and Scale
patternViews.description: Data-driven optimization of partner GTM execution across all dimensions.

narrativeContexts.context: Optimization expands partner GTM impact through data-driven refinement. Campaign performance data drives MDF investment reallocation. Deal registration win/loss analysis informs competitive positioning updates. Technical engagement mix is optimized based on customer outcome data. The expansion cycle is self-reinforcing.
